items.headline: Engleman's 43-yard TD run in 4th helps East Carolina beat Rice 28-12
items.description: — TJ Engleman Jr. ran for 136 yards that included 43-yard touchdown run in the fourth quarter to help East Carolina pull away and win its American Conference opener with a 28-12 victory over Rice on Saturday.

items.headline: East Carolina scores 6 TDs in first half to cruise past North Carolina Central 42-9
items.description: — Emory Williams threw three touchdown passes and TJ Engleman Jr. accounted for three scores, and East Carolina rolled past North Carolina Central 42-9 on Saturday.
